{"id":2078426284,"question_id":3820,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 hours, 10 minutes","timestamp":1784812929,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2078426284/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Number of Unique XOR Triplets II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int uniqueXorTriplets(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        unordered_set<int> st;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = i ; j<n ; j++)\n            {\n                int xorval = nums[i] ^ nums[j];\n\n                for(int k = j ; k<n ; k++) st.insert(xorval ^ nums[k]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        return st.size();\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"number-of-unique-xor-triplets-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2362}
